purpose: Define a consistent, auditable cost boundary for matched comparisons of complete engineering and agent workflows. This is a research crosswalk over existing receipts and evidence sources, not a new run receipt, billing ledger, score service, or product subsystem.
primary_unit: One independently adjudicated accepted task or workflow outcome, using the task owner's declared unit and the canonical benchmark receipt denominator.

accounting_lenses.reporting_rule: Report separately from deployed workflow cost. Include in deployment TCO only where the same activity is a recurring operational requirement.

Attribute all costs incurred across the complete eligible cohort, including failed, refused, unsupported, timed-out, ungraded and unattempted cases where cohort-level setup or commitment costs were incurred.
Declare the amortization horizon, workload volume, utilization and allocation method. Show actual-volume and sensitivity scenarios separately.

cost_dimensions.label: Model and provider inference
examples: reasoning or cached tokens where billed
cost_dimensions.monetary_treatment: Use actual net billed amount and report list-price equivalent separately when discounts, credits or negotiated terms apply. For local models, allocate compute under compute_infrastructure rather than inventing an API charge.
cost_dimensions.double_count_rule: Do not add estimated GPU cost for provider-hosted inference to the provider invoice unless it is a separately incurred cost outside that invoice.

cost_dimensions.label: Agent runtime and orchestration
cost_dimensions.monetary_treatment: Assign each billed line item once to this or another primary cost dimension.
cost_dimensions.double_count_rule: Do not add per-call estimates on top of a bundled runtime invoice for the same service.

cost_dimensions.label: Tools and external services
cost_dimensions.monetary_treatment: Include paid calls, consumption, licenses and per-seat charges attributable to the declared workload.
cost_dimensions.double_count_rule: Tool charges already bundled into a platform invoice are not counted again.

cost_dimensions.label: Compute, storage and network
cost_dimensions.monetary_treatment: Use billed cost where available. For shared owned assets, disclose utilization and a reproducible depreciation or capacity-allocation method; report idle/committed capacity rather than allocating only peak productive time.
cost_dimensions.double_count_rule: Choose either an invoice allocation or an owned-asset allocation for the same resource interval, never both.

cost_dimensions.label: Isolation, observation and independent verification
cost_dimensions.monetary_treatment: Include incremental resources required to make the outcome independently verifiable. Separate verification capability from the benchmark judge's study-only cost.
cost_dimensions.double_count_rule: If the verifier uses the same compute already allocated to compute_storage_network, assign the monetary amount once and retain verifier CPU/GPU time as a non-monetary diagnostic.

cost_dimensions.label: Human operation, review and governance
cost_dimensions.monetary_treatment: Report minutes by role first. Convert to money only with a disclosed rate basis, geography, tax/benefit inclusion and observation date.
cost_dimensions.double_count_rule: Do not count the same person's time in both a generic overhead allocation and a task-level work log.

cost_dimensions.label: Failures, recovery and rework
cost_dimensions.monetary_treatment: Include costs actually incurred across all attempts in the cohort. Report critical safety, security and authority failures separately as hard-gate outcomes; do not monetize them into a score that can be offset.
cost_dimensions.double_count_rule: Where a retry's provider or compute spend is already included in usage totals, add only additional labor or remediation not already counted.

cost_dimensions.label: Integration, maintenance and migration
cost_dimensions.monetary_treatment: Report one-time and recurring amounts separately. Amortize only with an explicit horizon, expected and observed volume, and sensitivity range.
cost_dimensions.double_count_rule: Do not bury integration effort in both per-task labor and an annual overhead allocation.

cost_dimensions.label: Licenses, support and commitments
cost_dimensions.monetary_treatment: Show gross list price, net cash outlay, unused commitment and utilization separately. Allocate minimum commitments using declared usage and horizon.
cost_dimensions.double_count_rule: Do not count a bundled license again as a separate per-seat or service charge.

cost_dimensions.label: Physical resource consumption and externalities
examples: embodied or operational carbon where measured
cost_dimensions.monetary_treatment: Report physical quantities per eligible and accepted outcome. Monetize only with an explicit tariff or externality method and keep the physical vector visible beside money.
cost_dimensions.double_count_rule: If electricity or cooling is already included in a cloud/facility invoice, do not add a second monetary charge for the same energy. Physical kWh remains a separate measurement.

cost_dimensions.label: Independent benchmark evaluation
cost_dimensions.monetary_treatment: Report as benchmark_campaign cost. Include in workflow_delivery or deployed_lifecycle only when independent evaluation is a recurring production requirement.
cost_dimensions.double_count_rule: Do not attribute one-time research gold-labeling cost to every production task unless that activity is genuinely repeated in service.

evidence_quality.meaning: Observed financial amount from invoice or contract with date, region, currency and billing boundary.
Directly observed resource quantity from a named meter or system meter with sampling window and calibration/source metadata.
Provider-reported units or spend without independent meter access; retain provider and export identity.
Observed role-specific minutes with a declared time-capture method.
Allocated or inferred value with an explicit formula, input provenance, horizon and uncertainty range.
Not measured or not available. Never coerce to zero; material unknown cost blocks a fully burdened cost-superiority claim.

derived_metrics.formula: total cohort workflow_delivery cost / eligible task count
derived_metrics.interpretation: Charges the arm for failures, refusals, unsupported cases, timeouts and non-attempts within the eligible cohort.

derived_metrics.formula: total cohort workflow_delivery cost / independently accepted outcome count
derived_metrics.interpretation: Primary economic outcome after every hard gate passes. Undefined when no independently accepted outcomes exist.

derived_metrics.formula: deployed_lifecycle cost over declared horizon / independently accepted outcomes over the same horizon
derived_metrics.interpretation: Requires observed or scenario-declared volume, utilization, fixed-cost allocation and sensitivity reporting.

derived_metrics.formula: all role-specific operational and review minutes / independently accepted outcome count
derived_metrics.interpretation: Report operator, reviewer, approver and exception-handling minutes separately as well as total.

derived_metrics.formula: metered energy, water and other declared resources / independently accepted outcome count
derived_metrics.interpretation: Report each physical quantity separately; do not collapse it into a monetary score without a declared method.

derived_metrics.formula: candidate cohort cost minus control cohort cost on the same frozen eligible task set
derived_metrics.interpretation: Use paired task-level costs and cluster-aware uncertainty; publish mean, median and tail behavior.

eligibility_and_claim_rules.denominator_owner: Canonical benchmark receipt and benchmark owner; no local denominator rewrite.
eligibility_and_claim_rules.accepted_outcome_owner: Independent task judge qualified under #11772, using the task owner's gold rubric.
hard_gates: task correctness is non-inferior under preregistered criteria
critical unauthorized effects are absent in the frozen control suite
critical stale-evidence false-current dispositions are absent in frozen critical controls
evidence provenance and result reconstruction meet the declared requirement
no safety, security, authority, physical feasibility or service constraint is violated
eligibility_and_claim_rules.missing_cost_rule: Unknown material costs are not zero. Report lower/upper bounds where defensible; otherwise withhold full-cost superiority claims.
eligibility_and_claim_rules.zero_success_rule: If an arm has zero independently accepted outcomes, cost per verified success is undefined; retain all costs and show the zero-success count.
eligibility_and_claim_rules.no_compensation_rule: Cost, speed, energy or human-time improvements cannot compensate for a failed hard gate.

existing_owners.role: canonical task universe, run identity, budgets and actual resource-usage reconciliation; no new receipt is introduced
judge qualification and independent accepted-outcome labels
claim classes, paired inference, cluster-aware uncertainty and Pareto reporting
engineering-change task universe, blueprint and independent gold-adjudication protocol
synthetic unauthorized-effect and recovery control outcomes
facility energy, useful work, QoS, water and grid-service resource accounting
manufacturing data/provenance interoperability use case; this crosswalk does not create a Mycelix ledger

non_claims: No Luminous cost, capability, energy, productivity or ROI result is measured by this crosswalk.
No provider price comparison is asserted; every price must be source-pinned to its region, date, contract and usage tier.
No cost result can establish correctness, safety, authorization, evidence validity or physical feasibility.
No universal currency-normalized or cross-domain capability score is defined.
This file is not a billing ledger, canonical run receipt, cost engine, score service or independent judge.
